description: Configurable weights for automatic Mauritius test-server selection. ISP affinity is contextual only and must not force same-ISP servers.

rationale.latency: Short probe RTT is the strongest available signal of path suitability.
rationale.packet_loss: Failed probe samples indicate an unreliable path to that host.
rationale.proximity: Catalogue distance_km is a coarse geographic prior, not a measured path length.
rationale.status: Offline catalogue entries must not be selected.
rationale.isp_affinity: Same-operator names are contextual only; a closer/faster other-ISP server still wins.
